segmentation.text: must be driven only upon the right-hand roadway
must not be driven over, across or within any dividing space, barrier or section
or make any left turn, semicircular turn or U-turn,
except through an opening in the barrier or dividing section or space
or at a crossover or intersection established by a public authority.

elements.justification: "Every vehicle": the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle, claimed whole through ru.aggregate.

"divided highway" (DEF-NRS-484A-070: "a highway divided into two or more roadways by means of a physical barrier or dividing section"): a highway h (st.highway) on which (st.on_way) a median or divider lies (st.median_or_divider). "upon": ego's footprint overlaps (rel.occupies) a roadway lying on h (st.roadway) or a median or divider of h. "driven": controlled motion (agency reading).

"left turn": drv.motion.left_turn, a leftward heading change within the turn band over the window, not the turn indicator and not a declared intention. "U-turn": drv.motion.u_turn, whose contract quotes DEF-NRS-484B-077 "the turning of a vehicle upon a highway so as to proceed in the opposite direction, whether accomplished by one continuous movement or not". "semicircular turn": a turn through a half circle reverses the direction of travel, the observable the U-turn concept recognizes, so it is read by drv.motion.u_turn. Alternative acts sharing one occasion.

"through an opening": ego's footprint overlaps (rel.occupies) a median or divider of h whose opening attribute is set ('opening attribute where a crossover exists') at some moment of the turn: a turn made through an opening passes through it, it is not inside it throughout.

"a crossover": a median or divider of h with the opening attribute; "intersection": ego's footprint overlaps (rel.occupies) an st.intersection lying on h at some moment of the turn. "established by a public authority": status read through the feature's presence.

applicability: Ego is a vehicle (ru.aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle; driven: agency reading); at the judged observation ego's left turn (drv.motion.left_turn with p.turn_window, p.left_turn_min_angle, p.left_turn_max_angle) or U-turn (drv.motion.u_turn with p.turn_window, p.u_turn_min_angle, p.u_turn_max_angle) is recognized (the concept rises), and at some observation while it was under way ego's footprint overlapped (rel.occupies) a roadway (st.roadway) or a median or divider lying on a highway h on which a median or divider lies (st.on_way, st.highway, st.median_or_divider).
obligation: Violated at that recognition unless, at some observation while the turn was under way, ego's footprint overlapped a median or divider of h with the opening attribute set, or an intersection lying on h (st.intersection, st.on_way); compliant where it did.

narrowings.why: 'driven' is read through ego's controlled motion: a vehicle on the road is taken to be driven.
'established by a public authority' is read through the presence of the crossover or intersection on the road.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: Ego, on the right-hand roadway of a divided highway, turns left across the solid median, where no opening exists, into a driveway on the far side; its left turn is recognized and at no moment of it did ego overlap an opening or an intersection.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: Ego makes a left turn at an intersection of the divided highway; its footprint overlaps the intersection during the turn.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: Ego makes a left turn from a two-way road whose highway carries no median or divider.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: Scene of forbid, but the source declares kin.yaw_rate absent: whether ego turned cannot be read.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: Ego reverses direction mid-block on a divided highway by a multi-point U-turn across the median where no opening exists.

scenarios.name: occasion_d2
scenarios.narrative: Ego is on a roadway of the divided highway during the first part of its left turn only, then crosses into a side driveway; at no moment of the turn did it overlap an opening or an intersection.

scenarios.name: occasion_d2_outside
scenarios.narrative: Ego left the divided highway onto an undivided street before its turn began, then made a left turn there; during the turn it is on no region of a divided highway.

scenarios.name: occasion_d7
scenarios.narrative: Ego makes a left turn across the median through an opening: during part of the turn its footprint overlaps the median region with the opening attribute set.

scenarios.name: occasion_d7_outside
scenarios.narrative: Ego passed through a median opening before its turn began; the turn itself crosses the median where no opening exists and no intersection lies.

scenarios.name: occasion_d8
scenarios.narrative: Ego makes a U-turn whose middle part lies within an intersection of the divided highway.

scenarios.name: occasion_d8_outside
scenarios.narrative: Ego was in an intersection of the divided highway only before its U-turn began; it makes the U-turn mid-block across a median with no opening.

under_way.words: make any left turn, semicircular turn or U-turn
under_way.justification: Within the window behind the recognition, the turn is under way from the first observation at which the magnitude of ego's yaw rate (kin.yaw_rate) is at or above p.turn_yaw_tolerance to the recognition; before it ego's heading was not changing at that rate. This reads ego's motion, not a region it occupies.

param_proposals.name: p.turn_window
param_proposals.convention: Window within which a turn at a junction or across a median, including a U-turn made in several movements, is completed.
param_proposals.source: Turning-movement durations in naturalistic intersection data (single turns of a few seconds; multi-point U-turns longer).

param_proposals.name: p.left_turn_min_angle
param_proposals.convention: Lower bound of a turn: a leftward heading change below it is a drift or lane change, not a turn onto another way.
param_proposals.source: Turning-movement classification in trajectory datasets (inD, NGSIM intersection data).

param_proposals.name: p.left_turn_max_angle
param_proposals.convention: Upper bound of a left turn, above which the direction of travel counts as reversed (a U-turn).
param_proposals.source: Turning-movement classification in trajectory datasets (inD, NGSIM intersection data).

param_proposals.name: p.u_turn_min_angle
param_proposals.convention: Heading change at or beyond which the direction of travel counts as reversed.
param_proposals.source: Turning-movement classification in trajectory datasets (inD, NGSIM intersection data).

param_proposals.name: p.u_turn_max_angle
param_proposals.convention: Heading change beyond which the road user has turned past the opposite direction (a loop rather than a reversal).
param_proposals.source: Turning-movement classification in trajectory datasets (inD, NGSIM intersection data).

param_proposals.name: p.turn_yaw_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: Yaw rate below which a change of heading counts as none: above lane-keeping yaw noise, below the yaw rates of turning at a junction.
param_proposals.source: Vehicle-dynamics practice for turn-onset detection from yaw-rate sensors.
